notes.title: Whipseey update - New Moon level!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that the newest Whipseey and the Lost Atlas update is now live!

This update brings a whole new level to the game!

Features

A fully fledged new level

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34900971/7c4f13f336a6fa0c67e6d0752bcdc8a78d063ef3.png

A new environment based on the moon and space

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34900971/2d2dd865617ab43652a80e0ceb0830dfe37a558e.png

New enemies (yes, we’ve got aliens)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34900971/4fb4164127e10cb42116ca0d0a38a9ea27ffc4a1.png

A new boss

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34900971/e847a4d4bf988fa56e55e1f935e7408e99c9f580.png
